attribution: alliance membership when the score event is recorded
eligible_account: profile is verified and has a non-empty unique email at season close
score_window: season start inclusive, season end inclusive
score_source: immutable FUR-3 military score events recorded with this rules version
membership_changes: historical points remain attributed to the alliance recorded at event time
multiple_accounts: globally identical email addresses are prevented by the existing unique index; separate email addresses are not reliably detectable and are not merged
